positive_label: fail: source +1 mapped to 1; pass -1 mapped to 0
split: sort naive source test timestamps, earliest approximately 70% for training; move boundary to next whole calendar day; all equal timestamps stay together
features: all source numeric measurement columns, excluding labels, timestamp and source line ID
preprocessing: training-only median imputation, discard training-all-missing and constant columns, training-only standard scaling
baseline: training-majority class with constant training failure prevalence as score
classifier: L2 logistic regression, C=1.0, class_weight=balanced, solver=liblinear, max_iter=5000, random_state=20261021
selection: no hyperparameter, feature, threshold or split tuning against held-out results; this is an exploratory first benchmark, not a preregistered external evaluation
uncertainty: 2000 paired test-calendar-day block bootstrap replicates, seed 20261021; fixed fitted model, no training refit; percentile 95% intervals
claims: semiconductor test-label classification only; no causal diagnosis, early-warning lead time, automotive transfer, savings or customer validation
